delivery.regulatory_basis: 49 Pa. Code §§ 35.201 and 35.358; current Commission Distance Education Course Application
delivery.method_approval_required: ARELLO/IDECC or other Commission-approved comparable certifying body

identity.exam_proctoring: Required for each prelicense course under 49 Pa. Code § 35.358(b)(2); approved procedure pending

reporting.state_workflow: Director-signed official prelicense transcript within 30 days under §§ 35.359–35.360; records available to student and Commission; annual provider renewal due by October 31.

records.state_rule: 49 Pa. Code § 35.360: complete financial, facility, personnel, curriculum, scholastic and attendance records; prelicense attendance and scholastic records retained 10 years.
